title: Shadows of Taumiel
description:
Shadows of Taumiel is a first-person adventure that combines exploration, stealth, platforming, and physics-based environmental puzzles.

After arriving at the mountain of Taumiel, what begins as a simple journey gradually turns into something far more unsettling. As you travel through forests, abandoned facilities, mountain trails, villas, and forgotten landmarks, strange events begin to blur the line between reality and memory.

Use the environment to overcome obstacles, manipulate physical systems, create new paths, and avoid threats that cannot always be confronted directly.

Features:

• Explore a large variety of interconnected locations across the mountain of Taumiel.

• Solve physics-based puzzles using objects, counterweights, pulleys, and environmental interactions.

• Hide, evade, and survive encounters with dangerous threats.

• Traverse rivers, cliffs, structures, and challenging platforming sections.

• Experience surreal dream-like episodes that reveal fragments of the protagonist's past.

• Discover multiple endings shaped by your actions throughout the journey.

Not everything you see can be trusted.
description_short: Explore the mountain of Taumiel, solve environmental challenges, evade relentless threats, and uncover a reality that may not be what it seems.
